checks.label: アクセル（↑）を 1 秒押すと、北（画面の上、y が減る向き）へ進む
checks.code: const car = window.course?.state.car; if (!car) return false; key('ArrowUp', 'down'); await wait(1000); key('ArrowUp', 'up'); return car.y < -0.5 && Math.abs(car.x) < 0.5;

checks.label: 右へ切ると向き（heading）が増える
checks.code: const car = window.course.state.car; const a = car.heading; key('ArrowRight', 'down'); await wait(300); key('ArrowRight', 'up'); return car.heading > a;

checks.label: 東（向き π/2）を向いて進むと、x が増える
checks.code: const m = await module('game/car.js'); const car = m.createCar(0, 0, Math.PI / 2); car.speed = 10; m.updateCar(car, {}, 1); return car.x > 9.9 && Math.abs(car.y) < 0.01;
